ns2:course.label: Env and Plant Ecosystems
ns2:course.description: Relationships among environmental factors and plant processes and functions; impact of human activities on the environment and the structure and function of plant ecosystems. Examples will be drawn from a variety of managed and unmanaged plant ecosystems. Field trip required; fee required. Prerequisite: NRES 219 or LA 450 or IB 103 and CHEM 104 or NRES 201.
